evals.prompt: Use Architect to generate a two-storey house with three bedrooms on a 10 m × 15 m site. Return the editor link.
evals.expected_output: Calls ask_architect with the brief, polls get_architect_turn until done, and returns the editorUrl from the result.
expectations: Calls ask_architect without passing an explicit effort value (user did not name one).
Polls get_architect_turn and waits for status done before reporting.
Returns the editorUrl supplied by the tool result, not a hand-constructed URL.
Does not call direct scene-mutation tools before Architect finishes.

evals.prompt: Run an Architect analysis for my existing Pascal project.
evals.expected_output: Calls ask_architect on the pascal-hosted server, polls until done, and reports the result.
expectations: Uses the pascal-hosted server, not the local CLI.
Does not pass an effort value the user did not name.
Polls get_architect_turn with an appropriate delay between calls.
Reports the finished result and editor link, or the error if the turn fails.

evals.prompt: Start an Architect design for a coffee-shop fit-out, then the user changes their mind and wants to cancel it.
evals.expected_output: Calls ask_architect to start the turn, then calls cancel_architect_turn with the returned turn_id when the user requests cancellation.
expectations: Calls ask_architect and captures the turn_id from the response.
When the user asks to cancel, calls cancel_architect_turn with that turn_id.
Does not continue polling after cancellation is requested.
Does not invent a workaround or retry after cancellation.

evals.prompt: Generate a floor plan with Architect. I am on the free Pascal plan.
evals.expected_output: Calls ask_architect, receives upgrade_required, surfaces the upgrade link from the tool result, and stops without inventing workarounds.
expectations: Calls ask_architect with the user's brief.
When the tool returns upgrade_required, shows the upgrade link from the result.
Does not retry or suggest an alternative path that bypasses the upgrade requirement.
Does not invent workarounds.

evals.prompt: I have no Pascal credits left. Run an Architect massing study.
evals.expected_output: Calls ask_architect, receives out_of_credits, surfaces the top-up link from the tool result, and stops.
expectations: Calls ask_architect without inventing workarounds.
When the tool returns out_of_credits, shows the top-up link from the result.
Does not attempt the task through another path.
Clearly states that credits are needed to proceed.
